license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Dentistry.

name.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Dentistry.

type.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Dentistry.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character and affirm that the applicant has no felony convictions or other criminal convictions that would affect the applicant's ability to render competent care.

degree_required.value: D.D.S. or D.M.D. from an approved dental college or university
degree_required.quote: Present satisfactory evidence of graduation from a dental college or university approved by the board, according to its rules and regulations.

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: an applicant for licensure has been awarded a D.D.S. or D.M.D. degree from a dental school accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations (theory and practice)
exams.notes: Written examination in theory and practice of the science of the profession
exams.quote: Present satisfactory evidence of having taken and passed an examination in the theory and practice of the science of the profession given by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations.

exams.name: National/regional/independent third-party clinical dental licensing examination
exams.notes: Applicant must apply for licensure in Louisiana within five years of passing; also requires jurisprudence examination and background check
exams.quote: An applicant who has successfully completed any national, regional, or independent third-party clinical dental licensing examination approved by the board and who otherwise satisfies all requirements for a dental license, including satisfactory completion of an examination in jurisprudence and a background check, may be granted a license by examination

interval_years.quote: the board may renew the license of a dentist or dental hygienist biennially.

required.quote: Require and determine by rule, minimum requirements relative to continuing education for relicensure and recertification.

topical_requirements.quote: Failing to maintain certification in an approved course of cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the renewal of a dental license.

available.quote: This Chapter shall not be construed to allow licensure by reciprocity which is prohibited.

requirements.value: Reciprocity is prohibited; licensure by credentials is available instead for dentists holding a license in another state
requirements.quote: Licensure by credentials shall be utilized to evaluate a dentist's and dental hygienist's theoretical knowledge and clinical skill when an applicant for licensure by credentials holds a dental or dental hygiene license in another state.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

credential_type.quote: Issue licenses, certificates, or authorities in conformity with this Chapter to applicants who have been found qualified.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

title_protection.quote: A dental licensee of this state, graduated from a reputable dental school has the right to use the title "Doctor" or its abbreviation before his name or append to his name the letters: "B.D.S.", "M.D.S.", "L.D.S.", "D.D.S.", "D.M.D." or equivalent letters signifying the dental degree conferred upon him.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affliction with a contagious or infectious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affliction with a contagious or infectious disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit issued under the provisions of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony before the board or in any judicial proceeding
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false testimony before the board or in any judicial proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual indulgence in the use of drugs, narcotics, or intoxicating liquors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual indulgence in the use of drugs, narcotics, or intoxicating liquors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering habit-forming or other legally controlled substances in other than a legal or legitimate manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering habit-forming or other legally controlled substances in other than a legal or legitimate manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional or dental incompetency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional or dental incompetency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dental practice which fails to satisfy the prevailing acceptable standards of dental practice in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dental practice which fails to satisfy the prevailing acceptable standards of dental practice in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or other remuneration with any person not licensed to practice dentistry in Louisiana
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or other remuneration or consideration with any person not licensed to practice dentistry in Louisiana

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding, or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist to engage in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding, or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist to engage in the practice of dentistry or to possess an ownership interest of any kind in a dental practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing unlicensed persons to perform work which can only be done by licensed dentists or dental hygienists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing unlicensed persons to perform work which under this Chapter can be done only by persons licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any misrepresentations or false promises to influence, persuade, or induce dental patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentations or false promises, directly or indirectly, to influence, persuade, or induce dental patronage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional connection or association with another for the illegal practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with, or lending his name to, another for the illegal practice of dentistry by another, or professional connection or association with any person holding himself out in any manner contrary to this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under any name other than that which appears on the license or renewal certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under any name other than that which appears on the license or renewal certificate, the dentist's commonly used name, or the name which is authorized under Chapter 11 of Title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in R.S. 37:775
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in R.S. 37:775.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct intended to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct intended to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct which disqualifies the licensee to practice dentistry with safety to the public, including mental or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct which disqualifies the licensee to practice dentistry with safety to the public, including inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill or safety to patients because of mental illness or deficiency or physical illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension, or restriction of a license by another state's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state to issue or renew a license, permit, or certificate to practice dentistry in that state, or the revocation, suspension, or other restriction imposed upon a license, permit, or certificate issued by such licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing solicitors or paying any person for the purpose of securing patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing solicitors or subsidizing anyone, or paying or presenting any person money or anything of value for the purpose of securing patients, except as allowed by R.S. 37:775.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to physical and mental examinations appointed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to the examinations and inquiry of medical physicians appointed or designated by the board to inquire into the dentist's physical and mental fitness and ability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or submitting false or deceptive claims to any patient, insurance company, or governmental authority for monetary compensation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or submitting false or deceptive claims to any patient, insurance company, or indemnity association, company, individual, or governmental authority for the purpose of obtaining monetary compensation for services rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided for by license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided for by license or permit issued under this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule, regulation, or order of the board, consent decree, or any provision of this Chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule, regulation, or order of the board, consent decree agreed upon between the board and the licensee, or any provision of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay timely a dentist license renewal fee as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to pay timely a dentist license renewal fee as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Non-disclosure of waiving of co-payments to any third party payor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Non-disclosure of waiving of co-payments to any third party payor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with the board in investigating any matter before the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to cooperate with the board in investigating any matter before the board except for an openly expressed claim of a constitutional privilege; or knowingly failing to respond to a lawful demand from the board for information from any professional licensing or disciplinary authority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain certification in an approved course of cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the renewal of a dental license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain certification in an approved course of cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the renewal of a dental license.

definition_quote.value: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial areas or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of his education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial areas or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of his education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.

methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial areas or the adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: A licensed dentist may administer general and local anesthetics and prescribe drugs or medicines necessary or proper in the practice of his profession.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed dentist may administer general and local anesthetics and prescribe drugs or medicines necessary or proper in the practice of his profession.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: When nitrous oxide inhalation analgesia, enteral moderate sedation, parenteral moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia are used in a dental practice, board authorization shall be obtained

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board reserves the right to inspect the facilities and/or assess the personnel covered under this Section. This inspection/assessment shall be conducted by a qualified person or committee duly appointed by the board. Such inspection and/or assessment may occur when a permit is requested or has been issued in accordance with the board's rules.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: Each licensed dentist or dental hygienist in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene in this state shall submit a written report within a period of ten days to the board of any mortality or other incident which results in temporary or permanent physical or mental injury to a patient requiring hospitalization of the patient during or as a result of administration by the dentist or dental hygienist of local anesthesia, enteral sedation, nitrous oxide inhalation analgesia, parenteral moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: For a patient under thirteen years of age, the administration of more than one agent of any type, including nitrous oxide, shall be considered moderate sedation, not minimal sedation, and shall require a full moderate sedation permit.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may operate under a licensed Louisiana dentist's direct or general supervision as defined in LAC 46:XXXIII.108, within the limits prescribed by the board in LAC 46:XXXIII.701.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: Upon promulgation of rules pursuant to this Section and R.S. 37:796, a person offering dental services at a mobile dental clinic or a location other than the dental office shall: (1) Be a dentist licensed in Louisiana who is in good standing with the board. (2) Have received a permit from the board to provide dental services at a mobile dental clinic or a location other than the dental office.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding, or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist to engage in the practice of dentistry or to possess an ownership interest of any kind in a dental practice

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: The employment or engaging of the services of any person, firm, or corporation to construct, repair, furnish, supply, or reproduce a prosthetic appliance or any denture, orthodontic appliance, bridge, or other substitute for natural teeth without the dentist furnishing a written work order on a form approved by the board

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist who administers nitrous oxide inhalation analgesia in a dental practice shall receive a personal permit from the board and shall be in compliance with board rules and regulations which shall include educational requirements.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Any dentist or dental hygienist applying for renewal of a license shall present satisfactory evidence with the license renewal application form that he is currently certified in Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Course "C" Basic Life Support for Health Care Providers as defined by the American Heart Association, the Red Cross Professional Rescue Course, or an equivalent.
